title: Lunch With Warren Buffett, Working for Berkshire Hathaway, and the Future of Investments With Ted Weschler
summary: Grace and Company as a Junior Financial Analyst before helping start the private equity firm Quad-C Management, where he was a partner for 10 years. In 1999, Ted went out on his own founding Peninsula Capital Advisors, which was a hedge fund he launched in 2000 above a bookstore in a Charlottesville mall. Ted lives in Charlottesville with his wife, Sheila, and two daughters.
